source_truth: Critical Lane Lockdown FAST audit: phone, desktop, browser, email, calendar are not proven for autonomous operation.

remediation_tracks.objective: Stop treating old backup containers as active product lanes.
remediation_tracks.behavior_proof_required: Backup containers are excluded from production truth and customer distribution.
remediation_tracks.rollback: Keep image/archive metadata; do not delete until explicit cleanup approval.

remediation_tracks.objective: Create correct health proof for infra services instead of assuming app /health endpoints.
remediation_tracks.behavior_proof_required: Seafile reachable/login/API proof; Jitsi browser-visible room proof.

remediation_tracks.objective: Prove Agent Lee can read desktop state and perform approved click/type/open action through existing desktop runtime lane.
remediation_tracks.behavior_proof_required: Approved harmless desktop action, screenshot/state receipt, rollback/no-op safety proof.
remediation_tracks.rollback: Disable desktop action endpoint and return to read-only mode.

remediation_tracks.objective: Prove Agent Lee can operate a controlled Playwright/Chromium session.
remediation_tracks.behavior_proof_required: Open local test page, click harmless button, capture screenshot, write receipt.

remediation_tracks.objective: Prove authenticated draft/create/send path with approval gate.
remediation_tracks.behavior_proof_required: Draft proof first. Send proof only after explicit approval.
remediation_tracks.rollback: Disable send endpoint; retain draft-only mode.

remediation_tracks.objective: Prove authenticated read/create/update calendar event path with approval gate.
remediation_tracks.behavior_proof_required: Create test event after explicit approval, verify readback, then delete/cleanup if approved.
remediation_tracks.rollback: Disable write endpoint; keep read-only mode.

remediation_tracks.objective: Prove phone/SMS/call lane only with explicit approval and either provider credentials or device bridge policy.
remediation_tracks.behavior_proof_required: No real call/text until explicit approval. Start with dry-run proof and provider/device readiness check.

remediation_tracks.objective: Prove customer entitlement, package validation, install/update/rollback workflow.
remediation_tracks.behavior_proof_required: License policy test, package manifest validation, install dry-run, rollback dry-run.
remediation_tracks.rollback: Restore prior policy and installer manifests.

remediation_tracks.objective: Restore/disable experimental vision/image/3D lanes based on product readiness.
remediation_tracks.behavior_proof_required: Health proof plus one harmless local inference/generation proof per enabled lane.

no_bridge_sprawl_policy.rule: Do not create new desktop/phone/browser bridge variants. Merge needed behavior into canonical runtime lanes.

next_action: Run U2B first remediation: archive/disable old backup containers from active truth without deletion.
